summary: Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Sherif Seddik as Chief Revenue Officer, effective May 1, 2026, succeeding Itai Greenberg, who is stepping down. The filing also includes first-quarter 2026 financial results. No specific terms such as stake, price, or premium are disclosed. The board recommended the change as part of commercial leadership adjustments. The event is a management change but appears orderly rather than forced, with no abrupt departure or contest. Watch for any further leadership transitions or strategic shifts that may follow this reorganization.
